tools.name: search-documents
tools.title: Document Search
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find, search, or browse study documents, lecture notes, summaries, or course materials on Studocu. Pass topic/keywords as `query` only — never put course name, course id, or institution name in `query`. `institution` is a display name only (this tool has no institution_id). Prefer numeric `course_id` from search-courses when you have it: it pins the course and overrules `course`. If both `course_id` and `institution` are sent, `course_id` wins; result institution is that course's university, not the name you passed. Otherwise pass `course` as name or code, never as a numeric id. `course` is optional extra if you already have `course_id`. Omit unknown filters. Returns matching documents with titles, course and institution info, ratings, and a link to view each on Studocu.

query.description: Topic/keywords only (e.g. "supply and demand", "microeconomics midterm 2025"). Never put course name, course id, or institution name here — use `institution`, `course`, and `course_id` instead.

institution.description: Institution display name only, e.g. "University of Amsterdam". Not an id — this tool has no `institution_id`. Infer it from the user message or conversation context when available; omit entirely if unknown. If `course_id` is also set, `course_id` wins; result institution is that course's university, not this name.

course.description: Course name or code only, e.g. "Economics" or "ECON101". Use when you do not have `course_id`. Never put a numeric id here. Optional extra if you also have `course_id`. Omit entirely if unknown.

course_id.description: Numeric Studocu course ID from search-courses `course_id`. Prefer this: it pins the course and overrules `course` name/code. Omit if you only have a name/code.

use_no_course_as_fallback.description: Only used with `course_id`. When true and that course has no matching documents, search again without the course, so results may come from other courses; check each result's `course_id`. Default false.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default: 10).

tools.name: search-institutions
tools.title: Search Institutions
tools.description: Search Studocu institutions by name when establishing or correcting education context (onboarding / context setup). Do not require this before every document search. Structured results include id, name, type, region_code, and country for follow-up tools. When talking to the user, present name/type/country/region only — do not show internal IDs. Auto-pick a clear top match; if the shortlist is ambiguous, ask the user to choose by name. Resolved IDs are conversation-scoped until a persistence capability owns them.

tools.name: search-courses
tools.title: Search Courses
tools.description: Search Studocu courses when establishing or correcting course context. Prefer institution_id from search-institutions to scope results. Omit institution_id only when the institution is unknown: results then include catalog institution_id, and institution_name when Algolia has it. Do not require this before every document search. Structured results include course_id, name, code (nullable), institution_id, and optional institution_name. When talking to the user, present name, course code, and institution name only — do not show internal IDs. Auto-pick a clear top match; if the shortlist is ambiguous, ask the user to choose by name/code. Resolved IDs are conversation-scoped until a persistence capability owns them.

tools.name: get-context
tools.title: Studocu Agent OS Context
tools.description: Return the unified Agent OS context manifest for the authenticated user: profile, followed courses, project metadata, and recent activity. Every project includes has_course_mastery and started_course_mastery (course supports Infinite Practice / learner has started it). Course mastery is visible only on projects, not followed_courses. Practised-topic detail (topic_masteries) is included only when a course is in scope (project_id, a sole remaining project, or remaining projects that share one course_id); the field is omitted when detail was not loaded. Empty topic_masteries means that course was loaded and the learner has no practised topics. Use get-course-mastery(course_id) for the practised-topic list when context omitted detail. Agent OS is read-only: chatting or calling this tool does not change mastery. Source of truth is Infinite Practice attempts (identity + course + topic); web IP writes, ACE/mobile/Agent OS only read.

project_id.description: Narrow context to a single project by id.

course_id.description: Narrow context to a single followed course and its projects.

recent_only.description: Limit the manifest to recently active context.

active_only.description: Limit the manifest to active context.

tools.name: get-project-state
tools.title: Studocu Project State
tools.description: Return sources and creations (project state) for one or more projects by id. Creation rows may include external_id (quizId or mockExamId) so a request-creation creating response can be matched once Alpha identity appears. Use after get-context (which lists projects without their sources/creations) to load those projects' artifacts. Only projects you can access are returned.

ids.description: The project ids to load sources and creations (project state) for. Only projects you can access are returned.

external_id.description: Kind-specific downstream id (quizId or mockExamId) for matching a pending request-creation.

tools.name: get-course-mastery
tools.title: Get Infinite Practice Course Mastery
tools.description: Return practised-topic Infinite Practice mastery for a course (topic_id, topic_name when available, display 0–100, questions_answered). Use after get-context flags (has_course_mastery / started_course_mastery) or whenever context omitted topic_masteries. Agent OS is read-only: chatting, creating artifacts, or calling this tool does not change mastery. Source of truth is Infinite Practice attempts (user_topic_mastery: identity + course + topic); display matches the web IP UI. Progress is learner- and course-scoped, not chat- or client-scoped — web IP writes it; ACE/mobile/Agent OS only read the same rows. Empty topic_masteries means no IP attempts yet, not a separate client score. Requires course_id.

course_id.description: Course id to load practised-topic Infinite Practice mastery for.
Course id whose mastery was loaded, matching followed_courses.course_id.

topic_masteries.description: Practised topics only. Empty means this course was loaded and the learner has no IP attempts yet.

tools.name: request-creation
tools.title: Request Studocu Creation
tools.description: Generate a Studocu quiz or mockExam from 1-10 project source artifacts. Waits up to ~3 minutes; returns artifact_id and external_id when created, status creating with external_id when persist is not yet visible, or outcome_unknown on client timeout or in-flight duplicate (check get-project-state before retrying). Optional idempotency_key is forwarded as Idempotency-Key; identical retries without a key still dedupe.

project_id.description: UUID of the Studocu project that will own the new creation.

type.description: The kind of creation to generate: quiz or mockExam.

artifact_ids.description: One to ten unique source artifact IDs (studocu://project/{project_id}/source/{uuid}) to generate from.

instruction.description: Optional free-text hint for the generating agent (e.g. "focus on chapter 3").

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key. Agent OS always sends Idempotency-Key to Alpha (this value, or a fingerprint of project/type/sources/instruction). Reuse with a different body is rejected.

artifact_id.description: Agent OS artifact ID of the new creation. Present when status is created.

status.description: created: persisted and linked (artifact_id and external_id). creating: generation finished but Alpha identity is not yet visible (external_id matches get-project-state creation rows). outcome_unknown: client timeout or an in-flight duplicate (check get-project-state; do not mint a new key). Terminal failures use MCP isError, not a status value.

external_id.description: Kind-specific downstream id (quizId or mockExamId). Present on created and creating; match the same field on get-project-state creation rows. Omitted on timeout.

tools.name: read-memory
tools.title: Read Studocu Agent Memory
tools.description: Read durable agent memory for the authenticated user. Returns one document per (scope, kind); use project_id for project-scoped memory. Identity comes from Core via the session bearer, not from input.

scope.description: Memory scope to read: global, project, or both. Defaults to global unless project_id is set.

project_id.description: Project UUID for project-scoped memory; null or omitted reads global (user-level) memory. Required when scope is project or both.

kind.description: Narrow the result to a single memory kind.

projectId.description: Owning project UUID, or null for global memory.

updatedAt.description: Last time this memory document changed.

memories.description: Durable memory documents for the authenticated user.

projectId.description: Owning project UUID, or null for global memory.
